Hi Rajiv —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, we want to run a short acceptance verification focused on your peak checkout flow (payment tokenization + recommendation lookup) and the high-frequency risk-check route. Goal is to validate the latency and throughput targets we agreed in the SOW and capture telemetry for our post-run analysis.

Quick proposal (high level):
- Test window: 2028-11-03 09:00–12:00 PT
- Scenarios: checkout-hot-path (avg payload 1.2KB), risk-check-batch (concurrent 1–50 RPS profile)
- Targets: p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 220ms for checkout-hot-path at sustained 120 RPS; risk-check p95 <= 450ms at burst to 400 RPS
- Success criteria: no more than 1% error rate; p95 within target for both scenarios; system remains stable (no OOMs/worker restarts)

I've attached the acceptance plan and the load script we'll use. Please confirm the test window and share the test account API key (or let us use the sandbox key you provided). If those times don't work we can shift to the afternoon.

Attachments: finsprint-acceptance-plan.pdf, loadscript-20281101.yaml

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Infrastructure Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference

Team —

Run completed: attached is the raw result bundle and a short notes file. Quick summary:
- Checkout-hot-path: sustained 120 RPS for 10m: p50 = 42ms, p95 = 205ms (PASS vs 220ms target)
- Risk-check-batch: bursts to 400 RPS (3 x 5m): p95 = 510ms (FAIL vs 450ms target)
- Errors: 0.6% overall, mostly transient 5xx from a single worker that recovered; Izzy from our infra team captured a core dump
- Observations: when burst ramps, upstream recommendation cache miss rate spikes and downstream database CPU climbs; appears root cause is cold cache and connection pool saturation on our side

Attachments: run-20281103-results.json, run-notes-20281103.txt

We uploaded raw traces and screenshots to the Drive folder. We propose a short follow-up on Friday to run a targeted cache-warming experiment (add a 2-minute pre-populate at 200 RPS) before we re-run the burst profile.

Rajiv
Head of Platform
FinSprint
